name: CPF (ILRS predictions) Data Source
description: Executable data-source (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no hostcalls but plugin.getConfig): request turns a TimerTick into the GET HttpRequest of an EDC CPF v2 directory listing (config listingUrl); select_file turns the listing's HttpResponse into the GET of the newest <target>_cpf_ file (config target); emit turns that file's HttpResponse into one SDS $OEM (position-only, the CPF's declared frame, UTC, intl designator from the ILRS id), consumed in memory by analysis/od.fit and never stored. hostcap/http-request makes both fetches. A transport error, a status other than 200, an empty body, a listing without the target's file or a CPF without positions fails closed. Nothing is stored, signed or published.

methods.displayName: Request the EDC CPF directory listing
methods.description: A TimerTick -> one GET HttpRequest for the EDC CPF directory listing (config listingUrl, default EDC's lageos1 CPF v2 directory), for hostcap/http-request. The flow's trigger sets the cadence; the provider's suggested one is every 12 h (the former module timer cpf-pull).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

inputPorts.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the EDC CPF directory listing.

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the EDC CPF directory listing.

methods.description: The listing's HttpResponse -> the GET HttpRequest of the newest <target>_cpf_ file in it.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the CPF listing: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the CPF listing: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the selected file.

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the selected file.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the CPF file: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the CPF file: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One SDS $OEM ephemeris (position-only, declared frame) for analysis/od.fit; never stored.

outputPorts.description: One SDS $OEM ephemeris (position-only, declared frame) for analysis/od.fit; never stored.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one frame into the next request or the parsed ephemeris on the calling thread; the host parallelizes independent sources and this module creates no threads.
